div.head: Cn 1018 20
div.ab: Wytan eac ealle ymbe friðes bote. 7 ymbe féos bote. smeagan swiðe georne.
Wytan eac ealle ymbe friðes bote and ymbe féos bote smeagan swiðe georne.
Let us all also have zealous concern for the improvement of security, and the improvement of the coinage.
Let us all also consider very carefully the enhancement of public safety and the improvement of the currency.
